title: Theo Thinks a Deductible Cuts His Taxes 😂
description:
Theo is sure his $1,000 car-insurance deductible means $1,000 off his taxes. Nora walks him through a $1,500 pole scrape and a $600 scratch, and Theo invents a brand-new word.

The deductible is the slice of each claim YOU pay before insurance chips in. Under it, the whole bill is yours.

What's your deductible, and could you pay it tomorrow? 👇

Follow for more numbers that change how you spend.

⚠️ Illustration only: US personal car policy, collision cover, $1,000 deductible per claim; repair costs are made-up examples. Real policies, premiums and tax rules vary. This is not financial advice.
